name: paseo-rooms
description: Shared Paseo rooms: relay/web application and Paseo desktop plugin

scripts.verify:plugin-distribution: npm run test:plugin && npm run typecheck:plugin && npm run typecheck --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web && npm run test:local-server --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web && npm run format --workspace @paseo-rooms/docs
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web && npm run format:check --workspace @paseo-rooms/docs
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web && npm run lint --workspace @paseo-rooms/docs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @paseo-rooms/docs
scripts.test:name: npm run test:name --workspace @paseo-rooms/relay-web
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:web && npm run test:plugin && npm run typecheck:plugin
